unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager universe governance
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The supplied repository snapshot designates the requested manager as knownManager=false with canonicalManager=null, yet the supplied manager universe includes MEAG and official sources confirm it is an active institutional asset manager with infrastructure equity capability including North America.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Human curation required to reconcile the fund-manager manifest: confirm and add the canonical MEAG manager record to the version-controlled universe, then rerun the census under a KNOWN_MANAGER scope. Do not auto-add.

notes: Mandatory scope disposition applied due to knownManager=false in supplied snapshot; vehicle-level census not performed beyond documenting scope issue.
